description.zh-CN: 开源 AI 聊天工作台的官方桌面版：一个客户端接入 OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / OpenRouter 等多家模型和本地 Ollama，多 Agent、记忆、MCP 连接器都在本地应用里，凭据加密存储。
description.en: Official desktop app of the open-source AI chat workspace — one client for OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / OpenRouter and local Ollama, with multi-agent chats, memory and MCP connectors; credentials are stored encrypted on your machine.

node.recommended: not required (Electron app with bundled runtime)
node.supported: not required (Electron app with bundled runtime)

runtime.note: Self-contained Electron desktop app (desktop README, measured 2026-11-14): no system Node, no Docker — unlike the self-hosted web edition, the desktop installer is per-user and needs no admin. Built-in auto-update; macOS builds are notarized. The desktop app talks to LobeHub's services for sign-in/sync — cloud models and sync still need a network connection (official docs).

direct-install.label: Official direct install (GitHub release installer)
direct-install.note: Downloads the official installer/dmg and installs per-user (NSIS /S on Windows, hdiutil + /Applications on macOS); steps contain all platform packages and are filtered by machine arch.

proxy-install.label: CN accelerated install (ghfast/gh-proxy channels)
proxy-install.note: Same packages; the download layer prefers proxy channels in CN and falls back to direct automatically.

openai.label: OpenAI official API
openai.notes: Keys are entered in the app: Settings → AI Providers → OpenAI (official docs, measured 2026-11-14) and stored encrypted by the desktop app ("encrypted token storage", desktop README). configTarget is the Electron per-user data directory named after productName (electron-builder.mjs comment); on macOS it is ~/Library/Application Support/LobeHub. AiBOX never writes keys to disk.

anthropic.label: Anthropic official API (Claude)
anthropic.notes: Same provider page and encrypted storage as openai.

google.label: Google Gemini
google.notes: Same provider page and encrypted storage as openai.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (one key, every model)
openrouter.notes: Same provider page and encrypted storage as openai.

ollama.label: Local Ollama models (free, offline, no key)
ollama.notes: LobeHub documents Ollama (and LM Studio / vLLM) as local inference backends; enter the local endpoint on the same Providers page. No key involved.

upgrade.notes: The desktop app auto-updates (built-in updater, desktop README); check = `LobeHub.exe --version` against the version the daily probe records; upgrade on demand = re-run the install route with the newer release (NSIS /S and dmg flows overwrite) or use the in-app updater. macOS probe uses /Applications/LobeHub.app/Contents/MacOS/LobeHub --version.

steps: Windows: Settings → Apps → LobeHub → Uninstall (or run the bundled uninstaller under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\LobeHub)
macOS: quit LobeHub and drag LobeHub.app from /Applications to the Trash
Optionally delete the per-user data directory (local conversations and stored sessions) — sign-in content synced to your account stays there
uninstall.notes: NSIS installs per-user under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\LobeHub (electron-builder default, oneClick:false assisted installer); the Electron data directory is %APPDATA%\LobeHub on Windows and ~/Library/Application Support/LobeHub on macOS.

risk.onUninstall: Local-only conversations, drafts and the stored login session are deleted with the data directory — content that exists only on this device does not sync automatically, so export or back it up first. / 会删除本地对话、草稿与已保存的登录会话——只存在这台设备上的内容不会自动同步到云端，请先导出备份。
